languageRule:
## Language

Always reply to the user in English: short, clear sentences. Code, comments, commit messages and pull requests are written in English.
msgApplyFailed: Install did not finish. Read the newest log in {0}, fix the problem, then run install again.
msgBackup: Your previous agy configuration was backed up to: {0}
msgBadProfileName: '{0}' is not a valid profile name. Use lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'.
msgDone: Done. Profile '{0}' installed as {1}. Scheduled tasks: {2}.
msgMissingTool: {0} is required but was not found. Install it ({1}) and run install again.
msgOldGemini: Your old GEMINI.md is in the backup. To keep any of its rules, ask agy to add them to profiles/{0}/GEMINI.profile.md.
msgPlan: This will back up your current agy configuration, install profile '{0}' as {1}, and register scheduled tasks: {2}.
msgUninstallHint: To remove it later: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "{0}"
msgUninstalled: Removed the scheduled tasks and the agy-self-config plugin. Installed skills were left in place.
msgWarnTool: Note: {0} was not found ({1}). Some features need it.
promptLanguage: Which language should agy reply in? (en, vi, ... Press Enter for the language of this computer)
promptProfile: Profile name (existing: {0}). Type an existing name or a new one
promptProjectMap: Project map tool: press Enter for graphify, type the name of another skill you use, or type none
promptUninstall: Remove the scheduled tasks and the agy-self-config plugin? (y/N)
